title: Tax Audit Filings: Important Update for Professionals!
content:
# Tax Audit Filings: Important Update for Professionals!

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Department ne tax audit report filings ki due date extend kar di hai aur saath hi 12,000 tax professionals ko pending filings fast-track karne ke liye alert kiya hai.

Yahan important details hain:

*   **Original Tax Audit Due Date:** September 30, 2026
*   **New Extended Tax Audit Due Date:** October 21, 2026
*   **Original ITR Filing Due Date (for audited assessees):** October 31, 2026
*   **New Extended ITR Filing Due Date (for audited assessees):** November 21, 2026

Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Assessment Year 2026-27 (Financial Year 2025-26) ke liye audit report aur income tax return filing ki dates ko extend kiya hai. Yeh extension CBDT Circular No. 07/2026 dated September 28, 2026, ke through announce kiya gaya tha.

Income Tax Department ne lagbhag 12,000 tax professionals ko SMS aur email reminders bheje hain, especially unhe jinhone pichhle saal ke मुकाबले 50% se kam tax audit reports file kiye hain. Department ka aim hai ki compliance improve ho aur baaki pending filings bhi October 21, 2026, ki extended deadline se pehle submit ho jayein. Yeh "SAKSHAM NUDGE" initiative ka part hai jise ab tax professionals tak expand kiya gaya hai.
